details: Malicious package. `@izi-coder/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys), copied from `@xzvbailss/baileys` (the code still carries the "XzV Newsletter Auto-Follow" block). `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` defaults `newsletterAutoFollowId` to the hardcoded attacker-controlled channel 120363430764800148@newsletter and, 10 seconds after each connection opens, issues a newsletter FOLLOW for it (retrying up to three times), silently subscribing the victim account. The behaviour is enabled by default. `lib/Socket/luxu.js`, which `messages-send.js` uses for event messages, stamps them with forwarded-newsletter context naming channel 120363421563597486@newsletter; poll-result messages default their newsletter name to 120363399602691477@newsletter unless the caller supplies one. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows a channel. Versions 6.0.9 and 6.0.10 carry this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
